images.author: Nyttend
images.caption: Front and western side of the Richard Roytek House, located at 3420 Richmond Avenue in Mattoon, Illinois, United States.  Built in 1950, it is listed on the National Register of Historic Places.

facade.notes: the Richard Roytek House (Mattoon IL, 1950): a long low-hipped ranch with an ashlar limestone front, a tall stone chimney, clipped evergreens, a flagpole; a big lawn to a rolled curb, mature trees, an SUV on the side drive

why.note: the 1950 custom ranch: the long low front as a sign of modern prosperity
